description: This file defines the RootNode class, representing the root node in an Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) within the RQL predicates AST package. It extends the SuperNode class and is intended to serve as the unique starting node in the AST.

classes.name: RootNode
classes.description: A specialized class representing the root node in the AST, which is unique and only appears once at the beginning of the tree. It extends SuperNode.
